full_judgment:
This revisional application is directed against the Judgment and decree dated 29-3-2001 passed by the Additional District Judge, Natore in Title Appeal No. 15 of 2000 allowing the appeal reversing those dated 29-3-2000 passed in Title Suit No. 192 of 1993 by the Assistant Judge, Shingra, Natore decreeing the suit. 

 5. The learned Assistant Judge by his judgment and decree dated 29-3-2000 decreed the suit, Against the said Judgment and decree the defendant filed Title Appeal No. 105 of 2000 before the District Judge, Natore. The learned Additional District Judge who heard the said appeal by the impugned Judgment and decree allowed the appeal and dismissed the suit. 

 I fail to understand what more is necessary to make out a case of irreparable loss and injury. In view of the discussions made above I am of the view that the appellate Court committed error of law resulting in an error in the decision occasioning failure of justice in passing the impugned Judgment and decree dismissed the suit. 

 In the result, this Rule is made absolute. The impugned Judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court is set aside and those of the trial Court is restored with the modification that the plaintiff shall file the application before the Zilla Parishad. Natore within 60 (sixty) days from the date of receipt of this Judgment to give him lease of the suit Ferry Ghat on year-to-year basis and the Zilla Parishad shall dispose of the same as per Article 240 of the Land Management Manual. In case the plaintiff fails to apply then the District Council will be at liberty to invite tender to lease out the same. No order as to costs.
